[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | render = [[File:Skree Wing.jpg|150px]] }} [[Skree Wing]]s are [[trophy]] items dropped by various [[Harpy|Harpies]] in [[Vabbi]]; they are also used to make the [[Nesting Material]] required to hatch a [[Black Moa Chick]]. Skree Wings are often used in plays and their feathers as quills. ==Acquisition== * [[Nightfall]] ** [[Vabbi]] *** [[Skree Raider]] *** [[Skree Tracker]] *** [[Skree Singer]] *** [[Skree Griffin]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Skree Wing#Drop research|here]].'' === Farming=== ====[[Forum Highlands]] with [[Desperate Measures]] quest active ==== [[File:Skree Wing Farming (with Desperate Measures).jpg|x150px]]{{clear}} This farming will remain useful as long as you do ''not'' accept the rewards, abandon it once completed and re-take instead as many times as needed. Secondary quests will not halt player's storyline progress. =====Solo===== Single players will face some challenge since Harpy groups have [[Distracting Shot]], [[Healer's Boon]], [[Renew Life]] and [["We Shall Return!"]] while facing disadvantage from highground archers when there is limited free areas to run away. Rocks and hills can be used to hide from arrows. Solo players can hunt groups without Griffins (their monks). [[:File:Skree Wing solo Farming (with Desperate Measures).jpg|Click here]] to see paths. =====Team===== There is no need to take 8 party members as long as the group can widstand a single group, but watch over-aggro. There is a [[Do Not Touch]] at the south, near [[Commander Sadi-Belai]]'s group.
